source_document: DEFM14C (SEC, filed 2023-05-11, CIK 0001747748) — Sources & Uses, Ten-Year Projections (Non-GAAP Operating Income FY2023E).
notes: Real public-to-private take-private: Silver Lake Partners + CPP Investments acquired Qualtrics at $18.15/share ($10.97bn equity financing: $9.22bn SLP + $1.75bn CPPIB; ~$1.2bn debt financing; 605,769,288 shares outstanding). Signed 2023-03-12, closed 2023-06-23 (verified via 8-K filed 2023-06-26, not the signing date). Entry EBITDA uses the proxy's disclosed Non-GAAP Operating Income FY2023E ($219mm) since GAAP OperatingIncomeLoss is deeply negative (stock-based-comp heavy, typical for a recent-IPO SaaS issuer) and is not a defensible entry multiple basis. entry_net_debt is an estimate (cash less debt at close is not separately broken out in the proxy's Sources & Uses); entry_enterprise_value derived as entry_equity_value + entry_net_debt against the disclosed equity financing total. Monetary fields are in absolute currency units (USD), matching the DealMetadata convention used by all companies.
